title_zh: 仙侠剧：法袍飘飘的奇幻世界
title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (12/20): Xianxia, Fantasy Worlds of Flowing Robes
note_en: 出 (chū) after a verb shows that the action brings something new into existence: 特效团队用电脑技术制造出……奇幻画面 "the effects team creates fantastical images." English "create" already carries that sense, but Chinese often adds 出 to verbs like 制造, 想, and 写 (想出 "come up with," 写出 "write out") to mark the result appearing.
